blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Veteran journalist Philip Lustre admitted that he felt scared following the cyberlibel case filed by Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio. However, but he pointed out, “I don’t let fear immobilize me.” Lustre, 72, was arrested in Quezon City on Saturday by virtue of a warrant of arrest for cyberlibel issued by a Davao City court. He was released later that day after posting bail amounting to P48,000. READ: Veteran journo held for libel, ‘unaware’ of case in Davao “The fear, it’s there. I’m not saying I’m good.
